mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 units signals robust consumer demand for dwellings, driving equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as housing activity correlates with broader consumption strength.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2000 units in 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, with statistically insignificant mean return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 198.0) signals monetary policy tightening pressure, causing short-term equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 198.0 but S&P 500 5d returns are positive in > 70% of instances, with Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and retail sales (RSAFS < 350,000) indicates weakening economic output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 AND RSAFS < 350000 but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, with interaction effect statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightening (UNRATE > 5.0%) reflects reduced unemployment, increasing wage pressures and corporate profit margins, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as equity valuations re-rate upward.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, with mean return not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recessionary risks materialize and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but S&P 500 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, with failure to reject null hypothesis of zero mean return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2000 units (HOUST > 2000) signals strong residential demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as housing activity precedes broader consumer spending growth.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2000 but S&P 500 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, with correlation coefficient < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising while FEDFUNDS remains stable (FEDFUNDS ≤ 4.0%) indicates delayed monetary policy response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as market uncertainty increases.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 198.0 AND FEDFUNDS ≤ 4.0 but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, with interaction effect not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts rising (HOUST > 2000) concurrent with declining retail sales (RSAFS < 350,000) indicates sector-specific demand strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as housing momentum offsets retail weakness.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2000 AND RSAFS < 350000 but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, with interaction effect statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).
